field.name: deadline_days
field.label: Rating deadline (days before race)
field.description: Rating changes after this many days before the race date no longer count for this race.

field.name: form_id
field.label: Entry form ID
field.description: The RSForm! Pro form this race's entries are read from. Leave empty to use the form set in the options (shown in grey); it is then filled in when you save. Change it only to link the race to another season's form: the question list below is reloaded for that form.

field.name: entry_field
field.label: Entry form question
field.description: The yes/no question on that entry form that asks whether a boat is entering this race. Leave empty to keep this race off the Race entries page.
